input.title: Income Segregation and Intergenerational Mobility Across Colleges in the United States*
input.authors: Raj Chetty; John N. Friedman; Emmanuel Saez; Nicholas Turner; Danny Yagan

verdicts.reasoning: Main regressions are OLS rank-rank: child earnings percentile rank on parent income percentile rank with college fixed effects. The DV is a percentile rank (0-100), not logged. Income is discussed throughout in dollar terms, but every estimated equation has rank or a binary indicator on the LHS — never log(earnings). Statistics reported across college tiers and parent income quintiles are descriptive stratification, not heterogeneous treatment effects.
